# ArchDaily

> ArchDaily is a global architecture platform publishing projects, news, competitions, products, and professional resources for architects and designers.

ArchDaily covers built works, interiors, urbanism, interviews, events, and product discovery, with continuously updated editorial content and region-specific editions. The site also includes awards, jobs, company catalogs, BIM resources, and submission pathways for practices and manufacturers.

## Main Platform
- [ArchDaily Homepage](https://www.archdaily.com): Main entry point for architecture projects, news, interviews, and featured editorial content.
- [About ArchDaily](https://www.archdaily.com/content/about): Overview of ArchDaily’s mission, editorial focus, and global architecture publishing network.
- [Contact](https://www.archdaily.com/contact): Contact information and submission options for projects, products, and editorial inquiries.
- [Subscribe](https://www.archdaily.com/subscribe): Subscription page for ArchDaily newsletters, updates, and member-facing offerings.

## Projects
- [Projects](https://www.archdaily.com/projects): Comprehensive index of published architecture projects from around the world.
- [Houses](https://www.archdaily.com/search/projects/categories/houses): Residential house projects highlighting contemporary domestic architecture and renovations.
- [Housing](https://www.archdaily.com/search/projects/categories/housing): Multifamily and collective housing projects across varied scales and contexts.
- [Educational Architecture](https://www.archdaily.com/search/projects/categories/educational-architecture): Schools, universities, and learning environments featured in the projects archive.
- [Cultural Architecture](https://www.archdaily.com/search/projects/categories/cultural-architecture): Museums, theaters, galleries, and civic cultural buildings from global practices.
- [Offices](https://www.archdaily.com/search/projects/categories/offices): Workplace and office architecture projects with plans, photos, and design descriptions.
- [Interior Design](https://www.archdaily.com/search/projects/categories/interior-design): Interior architecture and design projects across residential, retail, hospitality, and workplaces.
- [Urbanism](https://www.archdaily.com/search/projects/categories/urbanism): Urban-scale interventions, public space, landscape, and planning-related projects.

## News and Editorial
- [Architecture News](https://www.archdaily.com/architecture-news): News coverage of architecture practice, cities, policy, awards, and major developments.
- [Articles](https://www.archdaily.com/articles): Editorial articles, essays, explainers, and thematic architecture coverage.
- [Interviews](https://www.archdaily.com/search/articles/categories/interviews): Interviews with architects, designers, and industry leaders on practice and ideas.
- [Events](https://www.archdaily.com/search/articles/categories/events): Coverage of architecture events, exhibitions, biennials, and conferences.
- [Competitions](https://www.archdaily.com/search/articles/categories/competitions): Competition announcements, results, and analysis relevant to architecture professionals.
- [City Guides](https://www.archdaily.com/city-guides): Curated architecture guides and notable buildings organized by city.
- [Publications](https://www.archdaily.com/publications): Editorial collections and publication-focused architecture content.

## Topics and Collections
- [Monthly Topics](https://www.archdaily.com/monthly-topics): Thematic editorial collections exploring recurring issues in architecture and design.
- [Sustainability](https://www.archdaily.com/search/articles/categories/sustainability): Articles and projects focused on sustainable design, materials, and environmental performance.
- [Adaptive Reuse](https://www.archdaily.com/search/articles/categories/adaptive-reuse): Coverage of renovation, preservation, and reuse strategies in architecture.
- [Materials](https://www.archdaily.com/search/articles/categories/materials): Editorial content examining construction materials, finishes, and specification trends.
- [Technology](https://www.archdaily.com/search/articles/categories/technology): Articles on digital tools, fabrication, BIM, and emerging architectural technologies.
- [Urban Planning](https://www.archdaily.com/search/articles/categories/urban-planning): Planning, infrastructure, and city-scale design coverage from around the world.

## Video and Media
- [Videos](https://www.archdaily.com/videos): Video tours, interviews, documentaries, and visual features on architecture and design.
- [Architecture Drawings](https://www.archdaily.com/search/projects/categories/architecture-drawings): Project features emphasizing plans, sections, diagrams, and technical representation.
- [Photographs](https://www.archdaily.com/search/projects): Project archive with extensive photography and visual documentation of built works.

## Awards and Programs
- [Building of the Year Awards](https://boty.archdaily.com): Annual reader-voted awards recognizing standout architecture projects across categories.
- [ArchDaily Awards](https://www.archdaily.com/awards): Hub for ArchDaily-run awards, recognitions, and special editorial programs.
- [ArchDaily Campus](https://www.archdaily.com/campus): Student-focused platform featuring academic projects, resources, and opportunities.
- [Campus Awards](https://www.archdaily.com/campus/awards): Awards and recognition programs highlighting student architecture work and emerging talent.

## Product Catalog and BIM
- [Product Catalog](https://www.archdaily.com/catalog/us): Product discovery hub for building materials, systems, and architectural brands.
- [Companies](https://www.archdaily.com/catalog/us/companies): Directory of manufacturers and brands serving architects and construction professionals.
- [Products](https://www.archdaily.com/catalog/us/products): Searchable catalog of architectural products across materials and building systems.
- [BIM Objects](https://www.archdaily.com/catalog/us/bim): BIM files and digital product objects for specification and design workflows.
- [Materials Catalog](https://www.archdaily.com/catalog/us/categories): Product categories for browsing materials, assemblies, and construction solutions.
- [Featured Brands](https://www.archdaily.com/catalog/us/brands): Brand-focused pages presenting manufacturer profiles and product collections.

## Professional Resources
- [Jobs](https://www.archdaily.com/jobs): Architecture and design job listings for firms, studios, and related employers.
- [Submit a Project](https://www.archdaily.com/contact): Submission pathway for architects seeking publication of completed projects.
- [Submit Products](https://www.archdaily.com/catalog/us/brands): Entry point for manufacturers and brands participating in the product catalog.
- [Newsletter Signup](https://www.archdaily.com/subscribe): Subscription options for editorial newsletters and regular architecture updates.

## Regional Editions
- [ArchDaily en Español](https://www.archdaily.mx): Spanish-language edition covering architecture projects and news across Latin America and beyond.
- [ArchDaily Brasil](https://www.archdaily.com.br): Portuguese-language edition focused on Brazilian and international architecture content.
- [ArchDaily China](https://www.archdaily.cn): Chinese edition featuring architecture projects, news, and regional editorial coverage.
- [ArchDaily Colombia](https://www.archdaily.co): Regional edition serving architecture audiences in Colombia and Spanish-speaking markets.
